title: Iindwendwe Ezingaqhelekanga Zesixeko Esibiyelwe Ngodonga
intro: Iqela lafika emasangweni esixeko esasinabantu abangazange bazi inyaniso. Bazisa umyalezo, kodwa abemi baba nobundlobongela, besongela ngogonyamelo. Sekunjalo, besuka kwindawo engalindelekanga, ilizwi elinye laphakama ukukhusela abantu abangabaziyo, lilungiselela utshintsho olukhulu lweziganeko.
clues: Basijonga ngengcingane baza bathi, 'Ningabantu nje abaqhelekileyo njengathi.'
Indoda ethile yakhawuleza isuka kude kakhulu kwisixeko ukuze iqinisekise inyaniso yethu.
Wavakalisa ebantwini bakhe esithi, 'Kutheni ndingafanele ndimnqule Lowo wandidalayo?'
Ukukhanyela kwesixeko kwaphela ngomsindo omnye, kwaza kwathi cwaka apho babehlekisa khona.
arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
